common.tagline: Talk with AI. Keep every word.

metadata.title: MyVoiceLab — Talk with AI, keep every word
metadata.description: Talk with AI in any situation and turn what you said into something you can read. A new way to live — out loud.

hero.badge: No signup required — try it now
hero.lead: Talk your day into a diary.
hero.subCopy1: On days when writing feels too heavy, your voice keeps going.
hero.subCopy2: Say what happened today, and it turns into a diary you can read later.
hero.note: No signup — free for your first 10 exchanges

iosInstallGuide.title: Add to Home Screen
iosInstallGuide.subtitle: Two quick steps from Safari's share menu.

step1.body: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen

step2.body: Choose "Add to Home Screen" from the menu

iosInstallGuide.note: Once added, you can launch it like a native app.

steps.title: Just talk. It becomes a diary.

talk.title: Press the mic and talk about your day
talk.desc: Just say what's on your mind. No keyboard needed.

stack.title: The AI listens and shapes it into a diary
stack.desc: It hears you out, replies naturally, and keeps the conversation going with you.

visualize.title: Read it back later to reflect
visualize.desc: Your conversations are summarized and saved as diary entries you can revisit anytime.

features.title: A new kind of diary — done entirely by voice.

voice.title: Voice is all you need
voice.desc: Skip the keyboard. Just press the mic and talk. Pick from three calm voices to read your diary back to you.

conversation.title: Your conversation becomes a diary
conversation.desc: The AI listens and replies naturally. That back-and-forth is turned into a readable diary entry on its own.

summary.title: Revisit it on your own time
summary.desc: Browse past entries at a glance, or open a single one to reread. A quiet place to meet the thoughts you had, again.

tour.title: Speak, and read it back later.
tour.subtitle: A quick look at how the app actually feels.

recording.caption: Speak
recording.description: Press the mic and talk about your day. The AI chats back with you.

summary.caption: Shape
summary.description: The AI turns your conversation into a diary entry that's easy to read.

history.caption: Keep
history.description: Your diaries stay here. Come back to them anytime.

detail.caption: Revisit
detail.description: Open a past entry and meet the thoughts you had, again.

summary.title: Looking back on the meeting
summary.body:
The afternoon meeting was tense,
but I got my words out by the end.

entries.title: On a walk
entries.body: The evening park smelled of osmanthus. A small discovery, but I wanted to write it down.

entries.title: Morning coffee
entries.body: Changed how I brewed it. I hadn't realized beans could shift the taste this much.

entries.title: Something clicked at work
entries.body: I was able to focus and write for the first time in a while. Mornings still work best for me.

detail.title: On a walk
detail.body:
The evening park smelled of osmanthus.
I stood still for a while,
quietly making sure autumn was near.
A small discovery,
but writing it down like this
makes reading it back later something to look forward to.

conversation.text: I couldn't say what I wanted in a meeting — I'm a bit drained.
We were split over priorities for a new feature, and I couldn't find the words.
Which priority feels right to you?

summaryDemo.title: Reflecting on the meeting
lines: We were divided on priorities in the meeting.
I felt drained — the words wouldn't come out.
For me, nailing down the experience comes first.
